english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for hitting something hard.
Use this when the main point is that someone hits something particularly hard rather than repeatedly.
Use this when the focus is on hitting with great force rather than on the object breaking.

examples.english: I bang the table hard when I get angry.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 nau1 zau6 daai6 lik6 daa2 zoeng1 toi2

examples.english: I hammer the nail hard so that it goes into the wooden board.
examples.traditional: 我大力打支釘，先至打得入塊木板。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 lik6 daa2 zi1 deng1 sin1 zi3 daa2 dak1 jap6 faai3 muk6 baan2

examples.english: Don't smash the door so hard; you'll wake everyone up.
examples.traditional: 你唔好大力打個門，會嘈醒晒啲人㗎！
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 daai6 lik6 daa2 go3 mun4 wui5 cou4 seng2 saai3 di1 jan4 gaa3
